newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUMA SAYS EU GRANTS IT FIM 25 MLN.
newsitem.headline: RAUMA SAYS EU GRANTS IT FIM 25 MLN.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said on Monday the European Union had granted 25 million markka for research projects at its Sunds Defibrator and Timberjack units.
"Timberjack and Sunds Defibrator ... have received research grants worth more than 25 million markka ... from the European Union," Rauma said in a statement.
The goal of the project at the Timberjack unit was to develop "environmentally compatible timber harvesting technology" and to use this technology in a new generation of forest machines, Rauma said.
The Sunds Defibrator project was aimed at developing panelboard manufacturing to allow the use of recycled materials and to reduce process emissions and energy consumption, it said.
